ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized in the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized in the central peduncle region and dense surface mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central vertical region is solid black. Lateral lobes are predominantly white with extensive, semi-randomized black linear and splotchy geometric blobs distributed across the entire visible surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped depression at the central axis. Notch depth is approximately 1/5th of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged. Continuous frequency of pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, suggesting significant wear.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature transitioning to sharp, distally-tapered tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (approximately 5-8 visible) resembling barnacle attachment sites, primarily on the mid-to-lower sections of the white lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigment fields on both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive serration and irregular chipping along the entire trailing edge; multiple circular scarring events and heavy linear rake mark scarring throughout the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'scribble' pigmentation pattern where black linear markings create a high-frequency visual noise against the white background.
